inputs.name: ManageBodyValidator.owner.value
inputs.description: The unvalidated body of a `/manage/*` call; `register` and `device` both run this same check first. It must be a JSON object whose `owner` is a JSON object holding a text `id` of 1 to 200 characters, and whose `hostId` is 40 lowercase hex characters; otherwise `owner` returns undefined.
inputs.unknownReason: The owner credential envelope comes from an unvalidated management request body.

inputs.name: ManageBodyValidator.register.value
inputs.description: The unvalidated body of a host registration call, which must pass every `owner` check and also have a `hostKey` of 87 base64url characters, a `credentialHash` of 64 lowercase hex characters and a `name` of 1 to 200 characters. The `hostKey` is checked by its shape only and is not decoded as a P-256 point, and any failing check makes `register` return undefined.
inputs.unknownReason: The host registration body is raw request data until the owner and host fields have been checked.

inputs.name: ManageBodyValidator.device.value
inputs.description: The unvalidated body of a device call, which must pass every `owner` check and also have a `deviceId` of 40 lowercase hex characters. Any failing check makes `device` return undefined.
inputs.unknownReason: The device request body is raw data until the owner and device fields have been checked.

inputs.name: accountHolder.value
inputs.unknownReason: The Hub-managed session reference arrives as an untyped header or body field and is validated here.

outputs.name: ManageBodyValidator.owner
outputs.description: The validated owner body, holding exactly `owner.id` and `hostId`, copied from the input, or undefined when any check fails. No other field of the input is copied, so a caller's extra fields never reach the result.

outputs.name: ManageBodyValidator.register
outputs.description: The validated registration body, holding exactly `owner.id`, `hostId`, `hostKey`, `credentialHash` and `name`, copied from the input, or undefined when any check fails. No other field of the input is copied, so a caller's extra fields never reach the result.

outputs.name: ManageBodyValidator.device
outputs.description: The validated device body, holding exactly `owner.id`, `hostId` and `deviceId`, copied from the input, or undefined when any check fails. No other field of the input is copied, so a caller's extra fields never reach the result.
